(defstruct Big (a i64) (b i64) (c i64) (d i64))
(define g : Big (Big 1 2 3 4))
(define (reset!) : unit (set! g (Big 9 9 9 9)))
(define (observe [value : (& r Big)]) : i64 (reset!) value.a)
(define (main) : i64
  (observe (& g)))
